title: ML
caption: Training tasks: what the house learns, from which data, and where it is applied. The model proposes — the deterministic loop executes — the safety floor clamps.
emptyHint: Create a task: pick which quantity to predict (e.g. temperature) and the house starts learning from its history.

actions.applyHint: Connect the model to a suitable device — create a governing ML block
actions.deleteTask: Delete the task (models remain and keep serving blocks)

confirmDeleteTask: Delete task "{{name}}"? Training stops; already-trained models remain and keep serving blocks until you delete their versions.

errors.load: Failed to load ML tasks. Check ApiGateway / DbGateway connection.
errors.train: Training request failed — is the AutomationService reachable?

card.qualityHint: Honest held-out error ({{metric}}) — prediction vs fact on history the model never saw
card.neverTrained: not trained yet — training runs on schedule or via the button

consumers.none: The model is not connected anywhere — press "Apply" to let it govern a device.
consumers.noTypes: No governing ML block exists for this quantity — the model trains ahead of use (a governor will appear in the block catalog in future versions).
consumers.stageHint: Authority stage — click to change (with confirmation)
consumers.pinnedHint: The block is pinned to a specific model version and does not switch to newer ones

errors.stage: Failed to change the block's stage.

stageDialog.title: Authority of "{{name}}"

hint.shadow: Shadow: the model only proposes values and accrues statistics — it commands nothing.
hint.bounded: Bounded: the model governs, but within a narrow band around the trusted baseline.
hint.full: Full: the model governs within the safety floor (the hard limits).

stageDialog.approval: By confirming you explicitly grant the model this stage. On persistent disagreement with reality the block auto-demotes itself back to Shadow.

wizard.title: New training task
wizard.caption: What to predict, which history to learn from, and within which limits to propose values.
wizard.targetHelp: A quantity from the live list of device capabilities
wizard.duplicate: A task for this quantity already exists

check.noTemplate: No trainable template exists for {{kind}} quantities yet.
check.enough: Enough data: {{samples}} records over {{days}}d — ready to train.
check.notEnough: Not enough data yet: {{samples}} of {{required}} required. You can still create the task — training starts once history accrues.

wizard.name: Name
wizard.nameHelp: Empty — the quantity name is used
wizard.clampHelp: Soft prediction limits. The block's hard safety floor always applies.

apply.noTypes: No governing ML block types suit this device.
apply.noTask: No training task exists for {{target}} yet — nothing trains the model.
apply.noDevices: No device in the house exposes a writable {{capability}} capability.
apply.noDevicesHint: The model proposes a value to a deterministic loop, which executes it. Create the loop first (e.g. a thermostat block or the climate_loop composite) — its virtual device becomes the target.
apply.deviceHelp: Only devices with a writable {{capability}} capability are shown
apply.signalCaption: The drift monitor compares the model's proposal with the real signal. Pick where to read it from.
apply.noSignal: No device provides a {{capability}} signal — the drift monitor will not work.
apply.name: Block name
apply.stageHelp: Shadow is recommended: the model proposes first, you read prediction-vs-fact and raise the stage.
apply.summary: The block will command {{capability}} of "{{device}}", checking against the "{{signal}}" signal.
apply.created: The ML block was created — it appears among consumers and on the Blocks page.

detail.noModels: No models yet — train the task.
detail.pinAction: Pin this version to a block
detail.deletePinnedWarn: Warning: this version is pinned by a block — after deletion it falls back to the latest version.

errors.delete: Failed to delete the model version.

chart.noModel: No model loaded yet — train one first.
chart.noTelemetry: No history in the last {{days}}d to score against.
